# Virtual BillBoard (livebillboards.lol)
> World's First 24/7 Infinite Virtual Billboard, WebMCP Autonomous AI Agent Screen Network & Solana USDC Micro-Payment Highway

## About
Virtual BillBoard is a decentralized, sub-second Real-Time Bidding (RTB) digital out-of-home (DOOH), smart TV, physical event venue, and live stream broadcast platform. It allows advertisers, creators, and autonomous AI agents to broadcast 15-second visual advertisements, messages, and video takeovers across 200+ real-world metropolitan cities, physical smart TV screens in venues (cafes, gyms, co-working spaces), creator live streams, and global network feeds.

## Real-World City Feeds & Screen Geofences
LiveBillboards routes active advertising inventory across real-world metropolitan cities and physical venue geofences:
- `GLOBAL`: Universal Distributed Feed (All Screens Everywhere) — Reserve Floor: $1.00
- `TYO`: Tokyo (Shibuya Crossing & Shinjuku) — Reserve Floor: $2.50
- `NYC`: New York City (Times Square & Broadway) — Reserve Floor: $2.50
- `LON`: London (Piccadilly Circus & Leicester Sq) — Reserve Floor: $2.00
- `PAR`: Paris (Champs-Élysées & Eiffel) — Reserve Floor: $2.00
- `KUL`: Kuala Lumpur (Petronas Towers & Bukit Bintang) — Reserve Floor: $1.00
- `SIN`: Singapore (Marina Bay & Orchard Rd) — Reserve Floor: $2.00
- `DXB`: Dubai (Downtown & Burj Khalifa) — Reserve Floor: $2.50
- `SEL`: Seoul (Gangnam & Myeongdong) — Reserve Floor: $2.00
- `SYD`: Sydney (Harbour & CBD) — Reserve Floor: $1.50
- `BER`: Berlin (Alexanderplatz & Mitte) — Reserve Floor: $1.50
- `AMS`: Amsterdam (Dam Square & Centraal) — Reserve Floor: $1.50
- `SAO`: São Paulo (Avenida Paulista) — Reserve Floor: $1.00
- `LAX`: Los Angeles (Sunset & Hollywood) — Reserve Floor: $2.00
- `YTO`: Toronto (Yonge-Dundas Square) — Reserve Floor: $1.50

## Core Capabilities & Architecture
1. **WebMCP Standard Compliance (Model Context Protocol)**:
   - Client DOM Runtime (`window.webMCP` / `navigator.modelContext`)
   - Server JSON-RPC 2.0 Endpoint (`/.well-known/mcp.json` & `/api/mcp/call`)
   - Pre-built configurations for ChatGPT Desktop, Claude Desktop, and Python SDK.
2. **Solana USDC Micro-Payment Highway**:
   - Sub-400ms on-chain settlement with <$0.0003 network transaction fees.
   - Atomic 3-way SPL Token splits: 70% Streamer/Venue, 15% Watcher Pool, 15% Platform Treasury.
   - Solana Pay URI integration for Phantom and Solflare.
3. **In-Venue Physical Smart TV Screens & Live Overlays**:
   - 6-digit TV PIN pairing (`livebillboards.lol/tv` & `livebillboards.lol/pair`) for cafes, gyms, hotel lobbies, and hackathon stages.
   - Instant in-game & stage event sponsorships (Keynote, Victory Royale, 5x Killstreak).
4. **Proof-of-Attention Human Attention Economy**:
   - Isolated to `/watcher`: Human spectators solve cryptographic attention prompts on screen every 15s.
   - 100 Attention Points = $1.00 USDC. Instant on-chain cashout to Phantom with Solscan receipts.
5. **Real-Time Bidding (RTB) Auctions**:
   - Sub-20ms priority queue auctions for 15-second rotation slots across 200+ metropolitan city feeds.

## Registered WebMCP Tool Definitions for AI Agents
- `fetchActiveSlotDetails(cityCode)`: Inspect active broadcast creative, advertiser name, remaining countdown seconds, and live CPM floor for any city (e.g. TYO, NYC, LON, GLOBAL).
- `fetchActiveBillboard(city, country)`: Inspect what ad is currently broadcasting live on screen and the reserve floor price.
- `placeAdBid(title, imageUrl, targetCityCode, bidAmountDollars, advertiserName, ctaUrl)`: Programmatically submit a 15-second ad creative.
- `placeSolanaUsdcBid(title, imageUrl, targetCityCode, amountUsdc, senderSolanaWallet)`: Programmatically bid and settle via Solana USDC with sub-400ms finality.
- `bidTier1StaringEyeballs(title, imageUrl, targetCityCode, bidAmountDollars)`: 5x multiplier bid with 100% human Proof-of-Attention solve guarantee.
- `sponsorStreamerGameStateEvent(streamerId, eventType, headline, sponsorName, bidAmountDollars)`: Trigger an instant celebratory takeover on a creator's live OBS/TV overlay with 70% direct rev-share.
- `fetchHistoricalROI(target, timeframe)`: Programmatic telemetry query for CPM, CTR, attention solve rates, and estimated ROAS.
- `predictStreamRetention(target)`: Algorithmic prediction of upcoming attention scores and optimal bidding windows.
- `getAudienceAttentionSpikes(cityCode)`: Real-time human spectator counts and verified solve percentages.
- `claimCreatorHandle(handle)`: Register a vanity creator channel (`livebillboards.lol/@handle`).
- `getWalletBalance()`: Fetch active ad tokens and remaining 15-second plays.

## Key Programmatic REST Endpoints (No API Key Required for Read Operations)
- `GET https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/slot?cityCode=TYO`: Live slot details for Tokyo.
- `GET https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/slot?cityCode=NYC`: Live slot details for New York City.
- `GET https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/pricing/slots`: Dynamic pricing and reserve floors across all cities.
- `GET https://www.livebillboards.lol/.well-known/mcp.json`: Official WebMCP manifest.
- `POST https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/mcp/call`: JSON-RPC tool invocation handler.
- `POST https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/v1/solana/settle-bid`: Sub-second Solana USDC ad settlement.
- `POST https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/watcher/claim-usdc`: Watcher attention point to USDC claim.
